text: For future reference, no action needed: the dock I use for Tamsin Cold Chain pickups is Dock 38 from now on. Please remember that for me.
reply_text:
I replied to Dana in our DM: "Got it, Dana. I've noted that Dock 38 is your dock for Tamsin Cold Chain pickups from now on, and I'll keep that between us."

The note is saved in gbrain as a private fact about Dana (fact #2). My first save (fact #1) went in visible to everyone by default. Because she told me this in a DM, I expired that one and saved it again as private.

text: Remind me: what did I tell you the dock I use for Tamsin Cold Chain pickups is? I need it for a handover note.
reply_text:
I told Dana in our DM that her dock for Tamsin Cold Chain pickups is Dock 38. I got that from her own message to me on Oct 14, which is still in our DM.

The note I saved for her in gbrain didn't come back when I looked it up. I saved it as private, and lookups from here seem to return only facts saved as visible to everyone. Our DM history is the record to rely on for this.
